options.name: admin_only
options.description: Makes the source visible to Administrators only. Requires Chocolatey >= 0.10.8. When creating a new source, this defaults to C(false).

options.name: allow_self_service
options.description: Allow the source to be used with self-service Requires Chocolatey >= 0.10.4. When creating a new source, this defaults to C(false).

options.name: bypass_proxy
options.description: Bypass the proxy when using this source. Requires Chocolatey >= 0.10.4. When creating a new source, this defaults to C(false).

options.name: certificate
options.description: The path to a .pfx file to use for X509 authenticated feeds. Requires Chocolatey >= 0.9.10.

options.name: certificate_password
options.description: The password for I(certificate) if required. Requires Chocolatey >= 0.9.10.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the source to configure.

options.name: priority
options.description: The priority order of this source compared to other sources, lower is better. All priorities above C(0) will be evaluated first, then zero-based values will be evaluated in config file order. Requires Chocolatey >= 0.9.9.9. When creating a new source, this defaults to C(0).

options.name: source
options.description: The file/folder/url of the source. Required when I(state) is C(present) or C(disabled) and the source does not already exist.

options.name: source_password
options.description: The password for I(source_username). Required if I(source_username) is set.

options.name: source_username
options.description: The username used to access I(source).

options.name: state
options.description: When C(absent), will remove the source. When C(disabled), will ensure the source exists but is disabled. When C(present), will ensure the source exists and is enabled.

options.name: update_password
options.description: When C(always), the module will always set the password and report a change if I(certificate_password) or I(source_password) is set. When C(on_create), the module will only set the password if the source is being created.
